notes: Absentee condo owner-landlord relocating, wants agent to lease their Hell's Kitchen condo. A lead to win. shouldExtractParty=true. Address gradeable.

input.subject: Landlord looking for an agent to rent out my condo - Hell's Kitchen
input.bodyText:
Hi Ryan,

I'm being relocated to Chicago for work and rather than sell I want to rent out my condo. It's a 1BR/1BA at 555 W 44th St, unit 8H - full-service building, doorman, gym, great light facing south. About 720 sf.

I was thinking $4,500/mo but I'm open to your opinion. I'll need someone to handle everything since I'll be out of state by mid-September. Can you manage the listing, showings, and tenant screening? Let me know your fee structure.

Thanks so much,
Marcus
